manifest.name: Category Pilot
installationSteps: Install and configure Creator Controls first.
Import Category Pilot, approve its Process Probe and the Creator Controls profile actions used by mappings.
Start in Suggest only mode and attach Apply/Dismiss only to creator-controlled triggers.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its bounded last decision remains preserved for later review.

healthChecks.description: Confirms allowlisted process probes and suggestion controls are available.
